Conductor verified independently at ab96dc25: node --test packages/diagnostics-model.test.js 6 pass / 0 fail; node --check on both files exit 0; git diff --check debcfeef..HEAD exit 0; and a purity grep for fetch|readFile|writeFile|Date.now|Math.random|setTimeout|document|window|require( returns 0 hits, so the module is a view model and not a data source. Conductor checks on the two halves of the delta: input validation is rejection-not-repair (normalizeIncident/normalizeEvent return {ok:false, errors[]} and refuse unknown keys, so a record carrying renderer/html/fetch cannot enter the model, and a frozen input proves no mutation); stable filtering is proven by buildTimeline sorting on at with a positional tiebreak so same-instant events keep arrival order, with discarded records counted as {dropped, invalid} rather than hidden; decideDrift returns drifted:false plus a reason naming the unusable input for non-finite expected/actual/tolerance, so the view never invents drift. API: SEVERITIES, normalizeIncident, normalizeEvent, buildTimeline, decideDrift - no DOM, no I/O, no imports at all. NOTE for the next unit: the survey records two coexisting event-type vocabularies (dotted-lowercase on the wire vs verb = event_type.split('.')[-1].lower() in graph_ingest.py:90), so eventType stays an open non-empty string here rather than a closed enum - closing it would be a contract change and belongs with the API unit, not a pure model.
